args.body:
**Decision needed: fixed-price products were increased by mistake.**
- The 3% increase I applied on 2026-10-14 also hit 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 to P-1222). These should have been excluded.
- Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices. The total overcharge is 4,128.60.
- Proposed fix: I revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices. Orders already placed would need credits or corrections from the owners of those orders (finance or sales ops). I have not changed any prices yet.
- Please confirm the revert and tell me who should handle the order corrections.
